Somnoire: Illusive Realms

Quest Type

Tutorial

Requirements

Log in while Depths of Illusive Realm event is ongoing. Reach Union Level 17.

Description

A mysterious gateway emerges in the Whining Aix's Mire, providing access to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris.

Steps[]

  1. Go to the Whining Aix's Mire
  2. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
  3. Defeat the Tacet Discords (0/2)
  4. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
  5. Enter the Somnoire
  6. Clear the Somnoire
    1. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
    2. Talk to Illusia
    3. Talk to the Strange White Cat
    4. Proceed to the next Memory Zone
    5. Defeat the monsters
    6. Talk to the Strange White Cat
    7. Proceed to the next Memory Zone
    8. Defeat the monsters
    9. Talk to the Strange White Cat
    10. Defeat the monsters
    11. Talk to Ivory Gatekeeper
    12. Proceed to the next Memory Zone
    13. Defeat the monsters
    14. Talk to the Strange White Cat
    15. Proceed to the next Memory Zone
    16. Restore HP
    17. Talk to the Strange White Cat
    18. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
    19. Proceed to the next Memory Zone
    20. Defeat the monsters
    21. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
    22. Leave Somnoire
  7. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is limited to the Depths of Illusive Realm event.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
A strange frequency has led you to Whining Aix's Mire. A mysterious "Gate" stands here, spelling a secret revelation of the past.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Here you are.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I've been waiting for you.
Who are you?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Call me the Gatekeeper for now. My name doesn't matter. What really matters is the Gate here.
Why were you waiting for me?
Ebony Gatekeeper: The gate has been waiting for you, to be more exact.
What is this Gate?
What's inside it?
Where does it lead to?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Behind this gate lies the Somnoire, a space where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge.
Ebony Gatekeeper: It remembers the sweetness of a child's coveted candy and the madness entwined in a dictator's schemes. It delves into the depths of life's subconscious, acquainted with both its beauty and baseness.
Ebony Gatekeeper: In other words, it holds the dreams of all living beings, eternally recorded.
Who made this space?
Ebony Gatekeeper: It's made up of the experiences of every individual on Solaris-3 throughout history.
Does it have anything to do with me?
Ebony Gatekeeper: The Somnoire records everything on our planet, with your existence being a crucial component for its normal functioning.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Before your reawakening, something that shouldn't have been there had infiltrated the Somnoire.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Now, the Somnoire is in a state of chaos, and your assistance is much needed to restore its stability--Wait, something's not right...

Before he could finish the sentence, several Tacet Discords suddenly emerged from the Gate...

Ebony Gatekeeper: Tacet Discords are coming out of the Gate...
Ebony Gatekeeper: The situation inside Somnoire must be worse than I thought.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Impressive.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Now I am more confident you'd be able to help us restore the Somnoire to its normal state.
I still don't understand what this Gate is.
But it looks dangerous.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I can't explain it further to you just yet. Not before you regain your memories.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Authentic memories and experiences are imperative for the Somnoire, and I can't casually tamper with them.
Ebony Gatekeeper: At least you now know Tacet Discords are coming out of it. It's kind of like the Tacet Fields.
Ebony Gatekeeper: If you can help us fix the Somnoire, we may be able to prevent more Tacet Discords from showing up. It's like clearing the Tacet Fields.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Of course, you will be adequately compensated. What do you say?
I can't sit back and watch more TDs show up.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Yes, you've always been like this... Perhaps this why the Gate has chosen you.
Tell me how much you're paying first.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Yes, you've always been like this... Rest assured. I guarantee you'll receive generous rewards.
I want to know more about the Gate.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Once you enter the Gate and see those anomalies with your own eyes, you'll naturally learn more about the Somnoire.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Time is ticking. Let's get inside, then.

(Cutscene plays)(Cutscene ends)

Ebony Gatekeeper: As you can see, we are now inside the Somnoire. What do you think of it?
It's beautiful.
It's bizarre.
I've never seen anything like this before.
Ebony Gatekeeper: After all, it's made up of the memories and dreams of countless individuals.
Ebony Gatekeeper: What happens in dreams is always beyond our imagination.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Back to the point, in the Somnoire, you'll encounter other entities apart from me.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Like her.
Who is she?
Ebony Gatekeeper: She is a virtual entity, a conglomeration of the countless consciousnesses within the Gate.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Just think of her as someone dreaming, but she doesn't truly exist. She's just an Illusia created by the Gate.
Will she attack me?
Ebony Gatekeeper: No. She is friendly.
Why is she here?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Because there's gotta be someone dreaming in a dreamscape, right?
Ebony Gatekeeper: In fact, she will be your valuable assistant in the Somnoire.
Ebony Gatekeeper: You cannot bring anything inside here. If you need anything in battle, you'll need to manifest them from recorded memories.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Such as... the Echoes you use in battle.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Go talk to her. She'll provide you with the necessary ingredients for your dream.
Illusia: Ah, hello. Are you dreaming too?
Are you really dreaming?
Illusia: Yes, I'm forever dreaming. You wouldn't believe what I've been dreaming of.
Yes, greetings, my fellow dreamer.
Illusia: Haha, hello, nice to meet you too. I haven't seen anyone as energetic as you.
Hi, please give me an Echo or two.
Illusia: There is no need to rush...
Illusia: Now that you've discovered me, I bet you're curious about the dreams I'd had, aren't you? I've been dreaming about a lot of cool stuff.
Illusia: Just now, I dreamt of...
Illusia: How do you like my dreams? Exciting, right?
They are very strong indeed.
Illusia: Hehe, I didn't lie to you, did I?
Thank you for sharing your dreams with me.
Illusia: You're welcome. I take delight in telling you my dreams.
Illusia: I've had countless dreams that go far beyond what people can imagine, but sadly, I had no one to share them with...
Illusia: I'm more than willing to share my dreams with you, as long as you're interested!
Why not now?
Illusia: I understand you're here for business, not my dreams.
Illusia: You know something bad is happening here, right?
Illusia: Weird things have been gathering in the Somnoire recently, and as a result, I've been having nightmares...
Illusia: So I won't be keeping you here much longer. If you can bring things back to normal, we'll have plenty of time to hang out.
???: Meow!
And you are?
Lampy Cat!
Aw, aren't you adorable?
Ebony Gatekeeper: They aren't supposed to be here. This Memory Zone must have been corrupted, too.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Don't underestimate them, Rover. Be careful. We have no idea what kinds of enemies may appear in the current Somnoire.
???: Meow!
Nice to see you again.
Thank you for the gift.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
???: Meow!
Ebony Gatekeeper: Not sure what that thing was, but the Metaphor it provided should come in handy.
Ebony Gatekeeper: There is no such thing as an objective reality in this realm of dreams and memories. The more obscure something is, the more possibilities it holds.
Ivory Gatekeeper: Finally, you are here.
Why did you change your clothes?
Ivory Gatekeeper: ...
Are you the brother of the guy I met earlier?
Ivory Gatekeeper: No, I'm not.
Ivory Gatekeeper: Do not trust anything that man has told you.
Why?
What's your relationship with him?
Ivory Gatekeeper: We used to work together to guard and maintain the Somnoire.
Ivory Gatekeeper: But now, I would no longer call him a Gatekeeper.
Ivory Gatekeeper: You may have noticed how he is nowhere to be seen since you met me.
Ivory Gatekeeper: Because I've temporarily sealed off this area. He won't know you met me here.
Ivory Gatekeeper: However, you can't stay here for too long. He might become suspicious.
Ivory Gatekeeper: Before I leave, I'll provide you with some assistance.
Ivory Gatekeeper: I hope this will make your exploration easier.
Ivory Gatekeeper: By the way, I am the white cat you just saw. Hopefully, he couldn't tell it was me...
Ivory Gatekeeper: Anyway, this is important: Please remember what I said. Never trust that man under any circumstances.
Ivory Gatekeeper: Hmmm... That's enough talk for now. I trust you'll use your wise judgement to figure out what really lies behind that mask.
Ebony Gatekeeper: What took you so long to leave that area?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Ugh, enemies are everywhere.
Ebony Gatekeeper: But it seems you've become somewhat accustomed to the battles here. That's good.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I've got something for you... They should come in handy at some point.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Anyway... See that thing over there? It's the culprit behind the chaos and corruption in this area.
Ebony Gatekeeper: It looks tough to deal with. You should make good use of the Illusive Echos and Metaphors you've gotten so far.
Ebony Gatekeeper: That's amazing. I thought...
You thought what?
You thought I'd be defeated?
Ebony Gatekeeper: I thought this task wouldn't be easy, even for someone like you.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I underestimated you.
Ebony Gatekeeper: The Somnoire has grown increasingly chaotic and dangerous.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Recently, it has been devouring and copying all dreams without discrimination...
Ebony Gatekeeper: You'll encounter more bizarre occurrences in the Somnoire... Creatures, plants, Tacet Discords, and even your cherished friends.
Ebony Gatekeeper: While you are aware it's a dream, these sights may still leave a lasting impact on your psyche. I hope you are prepared.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Anyway... You did well today. I'll meet you outside the Gate.
Ebony Gatekeeper: How are you feeling?
What do you mean?
The monsters in there weren't that hard to beat.
Ebony Gatekeeper: You seem calm. Good. That means the Somnoire's effects haven't gotten to you.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Keep up with the good work, will you?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Well, now you've thoroughly cleared this area.
Ebony Gatekeeper: As you've probably already noticed, the Somnoire is really large, and what you've just cleared was just a tiny fraction of it.
Ebony Gatekeeper: To prevent future incidents like Tacet Discords escaping again, there is still much work to be done.
I have many questions about this place.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Well, you can come back here to get your answers, then.
I'll come here often.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I knew you're not someone to sit back and watch.
Don't forget the pay you promised me.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Of course, I'll be sure you get the pay you deserve.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Let's wrap up the exploration for now. Time to leave.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Next time, we'll delve into the deeper Memory Zones together.

As soon as the words left his mouth, Ebony Gatekeeper disappeared, as if what had just happened was a dream.

(Quest Complete)
